The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day. The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership. You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage. Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers. Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing. Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce. Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. quick_wins: Build a showcase Cypress + TypeScript repository containing Page Object/App Action patterns and integrate it with your GitHub Actions workflows to immediately eliminate the Cypress objection.
Add an event-driven test scenario using Testcontainers with Kafka to your existing Java or TypeScript test frameworks to demonstrate hands-on asynchronous testing.
Update your resume summary and LinkedIn headline to highlight Lead/Architect-level competencies: test strategy, non-functional testing (K6), and multi-platform automation.
skill_gap.career_advice: With 13 years of experience across web, mobile, API, performance, and CI/CD pipelines, you already operate as a seasoned Senior SDET. Cypress appeared in 17 matched roles not because it is superior to your current stack (Playwright/Selenium), but because companies have legacy or dedicated frontend stacks around it—close this gap immediately by leveraging your TypeScript background. Your strategic focus should now be pivoting from pure UI/API automation to architectural quality: asynchronous event-driven validation (Kafka), cloud architecture, and technical QA leadership.
